sources.snippet: MiniMax-H3 T2VA Prompt Rewriter LoRA An open, local prompt rewriter for text-to-audio-video (T2VA) generation with MiniMax-H3, fine-tuned as a LoRA adapter on top of Qwen3.6-27B. Generate the final audio-video with LightX2V.

sources.title: GitHub - ModelTC/LightX2V: Lightweight Image Video Action Generation ...
sources.snippet: Alongside this integration, we release the MiniMax-H3 T2VA Prompt Rewriter LoRA, fine-tuned from Qwen3.6-27B to transform concise user prompts into structured, H3-oriented multimodal descriptions spanning visual narrative, soundscape, and non-diegetic music.
